verdict.rationale: Sift is API-first. Its own REST APIs and SDKs (Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows) let applications drive it programmatically without a UI. A dedicated sandbox with separate API keys supports automated testing without touching production scores. However, nothing documents a CLI, an official CI integration, or guidance for running Sift in CI pipelines. missing for 10: documented CLI/headless tooling, CI pipeline integration guidance or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Sift easily integrates into your existing systems using modern REST APIs, Javascript snippet, and SDKs for iOS and Android.
You will send this data from your application to Sift via our REST API.
This sandbox environment allows you to send test events or client data to Sift without impacting the scores Sift produces in production.
